_comment: Edit this file to add or change a source. A source is only crawled when its access_rule is open_api or crawl_allowed, so changing a rule is a security decision and must carry its evidence in `basis`.

sources.name: Node/SeSTA CSO repository
sources.basis: robots.txt allows all paths. Node is a project partner, so confirm reuse with them as a courtesy even though the rules permit it.

sources.name: GuideStar India (CSIS India)
sources.basis: robots.txt allows all paths. Terms of use were not read, so check them before Sangam displays its certification levels publicly.

sources.name: NGO official websites
sources.basis: A class of sites, not one host: read each NGO's robots.txt and terms before crawling. Cohort NGOs can also give consent directly.

sources.name: NGO annual reports and audited financials
sources.basis: Public PDFs published on each NGO's own site, so that host's robots.txt governs. Download politely and one host at a time.

sources.name: NGO Darpan (NITI Aayog)
sources.basis: Every public search is gated by an image CAPTCHA that tooling cannot solve, and robots.txt answered 503 from outside India. A person must look each record up.

sources.name: FCRA Online (MHA)
sources.basis: robots.txt answered 503 from outside India, so its rules are unknown from here and automated access is unestablished. Manual lookup is allowed.

sources.name: Income Tax tax-exempted institutions
sources.basis: robots.txt answered 403 from outside India, so whether automated access is permitted cannot be established. Manual lookup by name or PAN is allowed.

sources.name: MCA21 company master data
sources.basis: Master data search is CAPTCHA-gated and robots.txt answered 403 from outside India. A person must look up CIN and Section 8 status by hand.

sources.name: MCA CSR-1 registry
sources.basis: No public search for CSR-1 was found and the host answers 403 to robots.txt from outside India. Take the number from the NGO's own certificate instead.

sources.name: MCA CDM Implementing Agency Master
sources.basis: Same host rule as the other MCA CDM products: robots.txt disallows automated access. Manual export from an Indian network is allowed.

sources.name: National CSR eXchange Portal
sources.basis: robots.txt answered 503 from outside India, so automated access is unestablished. Manual lookup of implementing agencies and proposed projects is allowed.

sources.name: Dataful NGO datasets
sources.basis: robots.txt allows /datasets, but downloads need a login and a paid plan. A written licence is needed before any of it appears in the open layer.

sources.name: FFRH NGO profiles and research folders
sources.basis: Shared by FFRH for this project. Public release of any CSO fact from it needs that CSO's consent under the DPDP Act.

sources.name: CSO self-reported vault uploads
sources.basis: Documents an organisation uploads about itself. Use is governed by that CSO's consent under the DPDP Act, and the files stay private by default.

sources.name: Hand-vetting fact-check sheets
sources.basis: Internal research in the org-grant-intelligence repo: each fact carries its source URL, date and verdict. The standard the importer is measured against.

sources.name: Social Stock Exchange registered NPOs
sources.basis: Neither the robots rules nor the terms have been read, and the register is used to learn what disclosures exist rather than as a data source.

sources.name: NGO social accounts
sources.basis: LinkedIn permits crawling only under written whitelist approval, and the other platforms require their own APIs. A person may read and enter a fact by hand.
